record.paper_title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement via nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping
record.context_brief: Boundary conditions for nonlocal conflict-generation model
record.original_question: For the nonlocal conflict-generation cognitive-map model with ∂_t k_i = u_i g,R Σ_j=1^n ρ_ij u_j − (μ + βu_i)k_i, in what sense do time-dependent solutions exist on a bounded domain with a top-hat detection function under zero-flux, homogeneous Neumann, or homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 20. In what sense do solutions exist solving the time-dependent problem (2.16) subject to zero-flux, homogeneous Neumann, or homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions with a top-hat detection function in a bounded domain?

artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search for existence theory for the specified nonlocal conflict-generation cognitive-map system with top-hat detection on a bounded domain under zero-flux, Neumann, or Dirichlet boundary conditions returned no resolution of the question. Related work on nonlocal advection–diffusion and cognitive-map population models exists, but none directly addresses well-posedness for this particular system with the listed boundary conditions. The status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Weakly nonlinear analysis of a two-species non-local advection–diffusion system
status_evidence.snippet: Studies a related two-species nonlocal advection-diffusion system without resolving the well-posedness question for the conflict-generation cognitive-map model with top-hat kernel on bounded domains.
status_evidence.claim: Related literature treats nonlocal advection-diffusion systems but does not settle existence for the stated cognitive-map model under the listed boundary conditions.

status_evidence.title: Global Existence of Solutions of Nonlocal Gierer-Meinhardt Model
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes global existence for a different nonlocal reaction-diffusion model on bounded domains; does not address the cognitive-map conflict-generation system with top-hat detection.
status_evidence.claim: Existing global existence results for nonlocal RD models on bounded domains do not cover this system.
